articles.summary: Colliers’ 2027 outlook points to renewed transaction activity, with investors increasingly focused on income growth, asset quality and active value creation TORONTO and LONDON, Nov. 17, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Valuations are recalibrating as global real estate markets adjust to a higher cost of capital, narrowing the gap between buyer and seller expectations and potentially unlocking transaction activity. With less ability to rely on yield compression to drive returns, investors are increasingly focused on growing income and creating value at the asset level. Colliers’ 2027 Global Investor Outlook brings together insights from Colliers' capital markets experts around the world and findings from our 2027 Global Investor Survey to identify the conditions that could unlock greater investment activity and shape where investors deploy capital. articles.summary: Leadership structure connects clients to opportunities across Mainland China, Hong Kong and international markets ASIA PACIFIC, November 4, 2026 Colliers has appointed Tammy Tang as Chief Executive Officer, Mainland China and Hong Kong and CK Lau as Chairman, Mainland China and Hong Kong effective 1 January 2027. The appointments reflect Colliers' continued focus on bringing together the strengths of its Mainland China and Hong Kong businesses to better support clients operating across local and international markets. Tang has led Colliers' Mainland China business for almost a decade, helping clients navigate change, strengthening market presence and driving growth in one of the world's most dynamic real estate markets. In her expanded role, Tang will provide strategic leadership across Mainland China and Hong Kong, helping clients capitalise on opportunities across the globe.
